title: Karen Silkwood and the missing plutonium

tellings.quote: that she discovered that they were missing 40 lbs of uh 98% bomb G plutonium from this facility

plain: In 1974 Karen Silkwood, a worker at a nuclear reprocessing plant in Oklahoma, is said to have found that the plant was missing 40 pounds of '98% bomb grade plutonium.' Dan Sheehan, who says he took part in the case, tells Michels this. If true, enough material for nuclear weapons would have gone missing from a US facility.
